nodes.name: aarch64 Cross-Compile Setup
nodes.summary: Technical notes on building a Rust cross-compile wrapper targeting aarch64 Linux from a non-aarch64 host. Covers the rationale for the wrapper, the libgcc_s / libgcc link mismatch when the host glibc differs from the target sysroot, and a from-scratch sysroot rebuild procedure that avoids the failure. Lists what was deliberately NOT needed (no custom cross toolchain, no glibc rebuild) and ends with the resulting build status.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation with 7 sections (1 H1 + 6 H2). Narrative/log style; no code blocks beyond a few shell snippets embedded in prose. ~113 lines.

nodes.name: Architecture Review 2026-07-13 — virtuoso-bridge-lite
nodes.summary: Standalone HTML page presenting a 2026-07-13 architecture review of the Python control plane (virtuoso-bridge-lite) for Cadence Virtuoso: VirtuosoClient, Domain Ops, SKILL builders, TCP/SKILL protocol, RAMIC daemon, SSHClient/SSHRunner, Spectre, and Maestro. Uses Tailwind CDN and Mermaid for an embedded flowchart of the current architecture plus per-candidate deep-module analysis sections. Quantifies scope as ~38k lines across 34 test files.
nodes.languageNotes: Static HTML with inline ES module import of mermaid@11 from jsdelivr CDN and Tailwind CSS via cdn.tailwindcss.com. Body in Simplified Chinese. ~117 lines, mermaid-heavy.

nodes.name: P0-A · 配置调用链盘点 (Config Call-Chain Inventory)
nodes.summary: Project planning document for the P0-A initiative tracking configuration re-read entry points on the production path and the migration to CommandContext. Catalogs the call-chain inventory of config-touching code, lists the refactor scope and ordering, and tracks 4 rounds of review fixes on the tunnel command family (local fallback, attach ownership, profile param, default port not constraint, forward-success proof, ControlMaster disabled, restart semantics, digest fields). Provides a 2026-09-08 status snapshot of merged / partially delivered / in-progress / pending work plus known local environment issues.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with 17 sections (H1/H2/H3 mix), dense Chinese narrative. Includes status tables and review-fix checklists. ~173 lines.

nodes.name: P0-A · 环境问题证据记录 (Environment Issue Evidence, Inconclusive)
nodes.summary: Companion evidence log to the P0-A planning doc, collecting observed-but-unresolved local environment issues: intermittent failures in streaming pipeline tests using transport::ssh, file-descriptor limit headroom, and a recurring cargo fmt segmentation fault. Each item is recorded as raw evidence with reproduction context, intentionally not auto-fixed. Closes with non-binding follow-up suggestions.
nodes.languageNotes: Short Markdown document with 5 sections (1 H1 + 4 H2). Chinese prose with embedded shell/log snippets. ~70 lines.

nodes.name: vcli GUI 调试能力建设复盘
nodes.summary: Self-contained dark-themed HTML retrospective on building out vcli GUI debugging capabilities. Covers the timeline, capability matrix, pain points (priority-tagged P0/P1/P2), delivered features (tagged Done), and quantitative metrics rendered via inline CSS grid cards and tables. Pure static markup with no external CDN dependencies — all styling and layout is hand-rolled CSS targeting a GitHub-dark palette.
nodes.languageNotes: HTML with extensive inline CSS (no JS, no external CDNs). Body in Simplified Chinese. ~363 lines; heavy use of grid/timeline/card patterns.

nodes.name: virtuoso-gui-debug × vcli — GUI 调试协同架构
nodes.summary: Light-themed HTML architecture document describing how the virtuoso-gui-debug tool cooperates with vcli to enable GUI-level debugging of Cadence Virtuoso. Presents the cooperative architecture, component boundaries, data flow between the GUI debugger and the vcli CLI, and deployment/integration considerations. Visually styled with a PingFang/Segoe UI system font stack and a soft blue accent palette.
nodes.languageNotes: Large standalone HTML page (~758 lines) with extensive inline CSS using CSS custom properties for theming. No external JS/CSS dependencies. Body in Simplified Chinese.
